name: Aberrant Moissanite
description:
Aberrant molecules of Moissanite mineral that have been altered by exposure to hyperdimensional forces. The Gallente Federation needs this aberrant material to be able to monitor the Drifter hyperspace interactions of other factions.

The Federation will reward anyone who accepts their campaign objective and delivers this to their item trader outside the Federation Navy Anchorage in <url=showinfo:5//30003788>Intaki</url>.
